guarantees.claim: The type sel_msglen_t is defined as a 1-bit logic enum with two members: SelIPadMsg (0) and SelOPadMsg (1).

assumptions.claim: Any signal declared as sel_msglen_t shall only be driven to SelIPadMsg (0) or SelOPadMsg (1).
assumptions.cond: when the signal is assigned or used as a select
assumptions.risk: If an X, Z, or out-of-range value is driven, downstream selection between inner/outer pad message length may be undefined, causing incorrect HMAC computation or protocol mismatch.

uncertain_points.claim: The enum base type is `logic`, allowing 4-state values (X, Z); no local mechanism prevents X assignment. If a driver produces X, the selection may silently propagate.
uncertain_points.cond: when any sel_msglen_t signal is not driven with a known 0/1 due to reset gap, uninitialized flops, or unconnected driver
uncertain_points.risk: Corrupted pad message length select could feed wrong data into the HMAC core, leading to incorrect digest or security bypass.
